name: Virtual Love Secrets
source: Virtual Love Secrets is a psychological horror and mystery visual novel. You awaken inside a bizarre, twisting labyrinth governed by entities like Sweet and Serles. To survive the harrowing corridors, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the limbo, every choice you make will determine whether you escape to reality or become just another permanent fixture in the collection.
translation: 《虚拟爱情秘密》是一部心理恐怖和悬疑视觉小说。你在一个奇异、扭曲的迷宫中醒来，由斯威特和塞莱斯等实体统治。为了在令人痛苦的走廊中生存，解决谜题，并揭开地狱边缘背后的真相，你所做的每一个选择都将决定你是逃避现实还是成为收藏中的另一个永久固定角色。
